A fixed, secret-free /usr/bin/flock helper applies the per-home kernel lock to the daemon's retained open-file description, preventing a retry from stealing filesystem authority from a still-live writer after PostgreSQL session loss.

Removes <tenantDataRoot>/branch-homes/<branchId> when a branch is deleted (archive retains). Path is derived only from the trusted branchId and tenant scope, never caller-supplied; force:true makes never-created homes a no-op (design doc §6.2, §8B.4).

Guarantees the per-branch SDK home --bind source exists before bwrap spawn; bwrap aborts on a missing --bind source and dropMasksForMissingTargets never drops a --bind (design doc §7.2, same precedent as the owner home store mkdir above).
Lazy-creates the tenant-scoped branch SDK home on first prompt (design doc §6.2); the bwrap --bind source must pre-exist (§7.2). Path derived from trusted branchId + tenant scope only.
Creates the per-tool subdirectories the relocated SDK env vars point at, inside the branch SDK home; daemon-derived paths only (design doc §8, §8A.7).
Opens the fixed /dev/null path read-only and no-follow so the daemon can functionally verify bubblewrap --bind-fd support without exposing tenant or credential data.
Runs a fixed secret-free bubblewrap command that binds the inherited /dev/null descriptor, proving the TOCTOU-safe descriptor-mount primitive before Agor admits the sandbox runtime.
Closes only the daemon-owned /dev/null probe descriptor after the fixed --bind-fd capability check.
Runs fixed `bwrap --version` with an empty input and no tenant data so Agor can require the 0.12.0 setup-path security fix before using bubblewrap as a boundary.
